name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Ultimate Edition
summary:
Edition includes:
- MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls
- Year 1 Characters and Stage Pass² (Includes set of result screen character poses, four characters and one stage post-launch)
- Howard the Duck (Lobby Avatar)
- Cosmo (Lobby Pet)
- Spider-Man “Advanced Suit 2.0” Costume
- Storm Punk Rock Costume
- Iron Man Classic Costume
- Captain America Classic Costume
- Doctor Doom Supreme Ruler Costume
- Animated Chromatic color unlock² for all 20 launch characters

²Set of result screen character poses is available instantly. The remainder of the content for the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass is expected to be made available by 31 December 2027. Costumes available until 5 August 2027.

Pre-purchase any edition of MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls to receive¹:
- Infinity Gauntlet (Lobby Equipment)
- Baby Groot (Lobby Pet)
- Cosmic Surfboard (Lobby Ride)
